originals.inspection: Full original actually inspected: white courtyard facades, recessed dark sashes, pale green hip roofs/vents, tower tall red shaft with narrow staggered white bands and huge ornate gray-white belfry/cap. Courtyard itself is open, not a roofed mass.

originals.caption: ROC Presidential Office Building, Taipei.
originals.inspection: Full1500x1001 local aerial inspected: two separate open courts, central low hall/barrel-like roof and central tower at east edge; four hipped corner towers, lower flat paired guard towers, standing-seam green wing roofs and white courtyard walls. Large modern structures behind/north are outside scope.

originals.caption: Taipei, Taiwan: Presidential Office Building
originals.inspection: Full5201x2957 original inspected through complete2048px view: front bay rhythms, grand central flat entrance porch, three arcade levels with recessed backing windows, top balcony, thin gray-white stripes on red piers; central belfry and gray pyramidal cap, four corner towers/roof vents.

originals.inspection: Full2048x1365 original inspected: real deep arcade openings with paired cylindrical columns and rusticated band blocks, segmented/round arch depths, recessed sash behind walkway, genuinely perforated balustrades. No baked facade photograph.

Full1600x1200 original inspected: front corner portico and broad side return, three differentiated arcade levels, fifth-floor recessed gallery, green metal roof with raised vents, gray banded basement, recessed tall shaft windows and ornate belfry. Stair/porch estimates corroborated.

primarySources.review: Official140m×85m approximate rectangular enclosure, central east–west axis separates north/south courtyards; four corner towers and paired guard towers. Actual native footprint is quantized and differs from overall approximate140m; preserve native controls without presenting photo details as survey.

Official approximately60m central tower; red brick/plaster decoration, differentiated2nd/3rd/4th floor arches and fifth floor recessed gallery; north side has no external portico, east/south/west do. Four octagonal courtyard corner chambers; current entrance porch and guard tower roofs are flat after wartime repairs; current roof vents are hipped, not historic domes.

2025 public20m ground model index retrieved and preserved. Official Taipei archive download currently returns403; no original20m data acquired and no accuracy claim. Terrain API documentation requires issued access key; none supplied. Alternate public2019 archive also returned403.

scope: Main surviving red-brick presidential office quadrangle with central60m tower, four corner towers, two flat guard towers, paired open courts, central hall and current entrance porches. Detached service/security buildings and precinct landscaping excluded.
exclusions: Historic monochrome27/29 show pre/postwar configurations; not current porch/guard-roof authority.
Military ceremonies, cars, people, palms, paving, fence/security/service annexes not modeled.

terrainAssessment.basis: Published third-party bare-ground derivative replaces rejected composite AFTER geometry. Actual bytes retained; source provider claims20mDTM; original official raster unavailable. External dry contact remains[0,55], relative datum5.1845m. No flattening/foundation fitting.
